overlay.fallback_signal: Overlay server omitted. Analysis grounded in authoritative native image pixels and source code analysis.

css_synthetic_probes.nature: CSS-only synthetic DOM probes (manually inserted test container, NOT production React component tree, NOT proof of full production responsiveness)

criterion_pill.note: Static status label div, not an interactive click target; 44px touch target rule does not apply.

forced_inline_grid_probe_320px.note: Forced inline grid test container; does not represent full runtime React ExecutionView tree.

findings.title: Raw backend serialization dumped in audit weaknesses (pontos_fracos)
findings.description: item.pontos_fracos renders unparsed string dump directly to user: Python bracket syntax, internal claim IDs (clm_historiador_2_fe580774), percent-encoded raw URLs, persona arrays, and chunk IDs (chk_567). Massive cognitive overload (Nielsen H8, H2) with 14 lines of dense unstyled red text.
findings.visual_evidence: Authoritative user image shows wall of red text under 'Fragilidades apontadas:'.

findings.title: Prior-cycle rejected audit persists during active re-search
findings.description: In Cycle 2, pipeline enters stage 'searching' ('1. Busca com Personas' active in tracker and blue info banner), but auditResult from Cycle 1 remains mounted ('0/1 pontos aprovados', 'Reprovado 10/12 critérios'). UI presents contradictory simultaneous states without distinguishing that the audit failure belongs to the previous cycle.
findings.visual_evidence: Authoritative user image shows 'Varredura web em andamento' with active spinner while box below displays 'Reprovado (10/12 critérios • mín. 11)'.

findings.title: Criteria numbers without semantic labels
findings.description: Grid items display only bare numbers 'Critério 1', 'Critério 2' ... 'Critério 12' without descriptive names (e.g., 'Ausência de Contradições', 'Embasamento Factual'). Users must guess criterion semantics or decode the unformatted text dump (violates Nielsen H6: Recognition Rather Than Recall).
findings.visual_evidence: Authoritative user image shows 12 pills with bare numbers 'Critério 1' through 'Critério 12'.

findings.title: Full card aria-live overload
findings.description: Top-level article sets aria-live='polite' on entire execution card (<article className='execution-card' aria-live='polite'>). When stage changes or massive raw text dump mounts, screen readers receive an uncontrolled flood of technical strings, overwhelming speech synthesis.

findings.title: Criterion justifications trapped in native title tooltip
findings.description: crit.justificativa is exclusively attached via HTML title attribute on static div.criterion-pill. Content is inaccessible on touch devices (no hover) and inaccessible to keyboard/screen reader navigation because the div is non-interactive and non-focusable (violates WCAG 1.4.13 and WCAG 4.1.2).

findings.title: Hardcoded status badge class on cycle indicator
findings.description: Header span displaying 'Ciclo {cycleNumber} de {maxCycles}' hardcodes className='status-badge-chip auditando'. Regardless of whether stage is 'searching', 'auditing', or 'writing', amber audit warning styling is applied.
findings.visual_evidence: Authoritative user image shows amber badge for 'Ciclo 2 de 4' while stage is searching.

findings.title: Copy phrasing and typography hierarchy
findings.description: Subtitle text in info banner concatenates comma-separated persona names followed by telegram-style period-delimited clauses without conjunctions ('Deduplicação de URLs e consolidação analítica'). Weak typography contrast against banner background.
findings.visual_evidence: Authoritative user image shows info banner subtitle with abrupt phrasing.

honest_limitations: Production dev research on port 3002 was strictly untouched; visual evidence derives authoritatively from native attached image.
Isolated tab on localhost:8011 used only for CSS-only synthetic DOM probes; not production React component rendering or proof of full responsive behavior.
Static status pills are non-interactive labels, not click targets; 44px touch target rules do not apply.
Navbar provides '+ Nova pesquisa' with confirmation modal; no claim of trapped user. Backend does not implement job cancellation API, so frontend reset cannot be recommended as true job cancel.
No live LLM/Jina API calls executed during evaluation.
Overlay server omitted to prevent interference.
